content_en.prompt: Pankaj wants to paint a coloring page. He sets up one rule: two touching areas must not have the same color.
content_en.question: What is the least number of colors he needs to fulfil the rule?
content_en.explanation: It is not possible to fulfil the rule with just 2 colors, as can easily be seen by looking at any three mutually touching areas — to satisfy the rule, all three must be colored differently. A coloring using just 3 colors is possible, as shown in the picture.
content_en.ct_explanation: In computer science, problems like this are known as the graph colouring problem — a well-known problem with many practical applications, such as splitting participants into groups for a sports tournament, scheduling, or traffic management. When a picture has many regions, this problem can become very complex to solve.

content_zh.prompt: Pankaj想要塗一張著色頁。他訂了一個規則：兩個相鄰的區域不能塗同一個顏色。
content_zh.question: 他最少需要幾種顏色才能符合這個規則？
content_zh.explanation: 光用2種顏色不可能符合規則，只要看任何三個互相相鄰的區域就能明白——要符合規則，這三個區域必須塗成三種不同的顏色。用3種顏色著色是可行的，如圖所示。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 在電腦科學裡，這類問題被稱為「圖著色問題」——這是一個知名的問題，有許多實際應用，例如把運動賽事的參賽者分組、排課，或交通管理。當一張圖有很多區域時，要解決這個問題會變得非常複雜。
